note: Type species of the genus Pilotermes, the genus and species characters published together in this paper; worker morphology is not treated separately, the author discussing the genus characters against the related genera Fastigitermes, Proboscitermes, Orthotermes, Mucrotermes, Procubitermes and Basidentitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The mandibles of the alate and worker are closest to those of Fastigitermes, Proboscitermes and Orthotermes: on the left mandible the distance from the apical tooth to the first marginal tooth is much greater than that from the first marginal tooth to the tip of the third marginal tooth (about 19:10), and the cutting edge between the apex of the first marginal tooth and the shallow notch in front of the third marginal tooth is flatly concave, without undulation; the second marginal tooth of the right mandible is distinct and the angle between the first and second marginal teeth slightly greater than a right angle. The soldier is closest to Basidentitermes (similar in the surface sculpture of the mandibles, the elongate maxillary palp, the first antennal segment, and the tibial spur formula including the spines of the middle tibia), but in this genus the anterior margin of the soldier clypeus lacks a broad middle lobe, the postmentum does not contract at the sides and its lateral carinae cross the lateral sutures, the head is more nearly circular in dorsal view, the mandibles are more hooked apically, and the base of the left mandible has no deep notch. Around the opening of the soldier frontal gland there is a tuft of conspicuously decurved setae, and the frontal gland secretion coagulates in alcohol into a firm, semitransparent jelly, as in Proboscitermes.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Head and body with a few scattered setae and numerous short hairs, the short hairs about one third as long as the setae and forming a thin blanket in outline; wing membrane with scattered short hairs; posterior margins of the tergites and sternites with setae, the surfaces covered with short hairs about half as long as the setae. Head yellowish brown, fontanelle white, postclypeus slightly paler than the head; pronotum concolorous with the head, with a pale T-shaped mark in the middle, a pale dot on each side near the anterior margin aligned with the branches of the T, and two small apposed pale spots near the middle of the posterior margin; wings brown; tergites and sternites slightly paler than the head and pronotum, each sternite with a pale area in the anterior middle. Head oval. The region between the ocelli is flatly convex, its outline almost a straight line, the upper margin of each ocellus slightly raised. Fontanelle small and oval, slightly less than or about half the ocellus length, slightly below the surrounding head surface. Compound eyes medium-sized, strongly projecting, close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli fairly large, separated from the eye suture by about one third of their length and less than their width; about the size of the antennal condyle. Antenna 15 segments, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2 and equal to segment 5, segment 3 much shorter than segment 4. Postclypeus with a median longitudinal line, about half as long as wide, moderately arched in profile. Each mandible with a long, rather stout apical tooth. Pronotum slightly more than half as long as wide, narrower than the head; anterior margin with a small median emargination, posterior margin more strongly emarginate. Mesonotum and metanotum each with a narrow, deep emargination, the angle of the emargination less than a right angle, and the angle of each pointed lobe also less than a right angle. Fore coxa with a blunt and indistinct longitudinal ridge. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Middle tibia with 2 outer spines near the apex. Wing membrane finely granulate.

Measurements (2 males, 2 females, mm): head length (to the anterior margin of the labrum) males 1.27—1.29, females 1.23—1.29; head length (to the anterior margin of the postclypeus) males 0.88, females 0.91; head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) males 0.75, females 0.76—0.79; head width males 1.17—1.18, females 1.18—1.21; fontanelle length males 0.06—0.08, females 0.08; eye diameter males 0.32—0.33, females 0.34; distance from the lower margin of the eye males 0.04—0.05, females 0.03; ocellus length males 0.15, females 0.16—0.17; ocellus width males 0.11, females 0.10—0.12; ocellus-to-eye distance males 0.06—0.07, females 0.05—0.08; postclypeus length males 0.22, females 0.22—0.23; postclypeus width males 0.48—0.49, females 0.46—0.47; pronotum length males 0.53—0.57, females 0.54—0.55; pronotum width males 0.96—0.97, females 0.94—0.95; hind tibia length males 1.18—1.21, females 1.23; forewing length from the wing suture males 10.90—11.09, females 10.90—11.09; forewing width males 2.68—2.80, females 2.56—2.64.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Anterior part of the head brownish yellow, the posterior part paler; pronotum paler than the anterior part of the head; legs slightly paler than the pronotum; abdomen nearly white. Head and pronotum with a few scattered setae, the anterior part with a few short hairs in addition. A tuft of conspicuously decurved setae around the frontal gland opening. Anterior end of the postmentum with 2 setae. Tergites and sternites with setae of medium length and a few indistinct short hairs. Head proportionally short, wide and thick, nearly circular in dorsal view; sides and posterior margin slightly arcuate; the anterior part of the dorsum blunt and weakly pointed in dorsal view; in one specimen of the series the posterior margin of the head is bilobed or weakly notched. In profile the vertex is rounded, almost vertical directly above the frontal gland opening; below the frontal gland opening there is a fairly deep but short transverse groove; on each side of the frontal gland opening there is a short vertical groove; the frontal gland opening lies on a swelling bounded by grooves on three sides but merging smoothly with the vertex above. Postclypeus rather short, its posterior suture visible below the gland opening. Sides of the postmentum without distinct contraction, slightly convex over the anterior three quarters; on each side a long, rather sharp longitudinal carina runs from near the base of the mandibles to about a quarter of the postmentum length from the middle of the posterior margin, and the two carinae cross the lateral sutures in ventral view; the postmentum is evenly convex in profile, without swellings or projections. Antenna 14 segments, segment 1 about equal to segments 2, 3 and 4 combined, segment 3 shorter than segment 2 and either shorter or longer than segment 4. Maxillary palps long and slender, reaching about seven eighths of the length of the open mandibles. Labrum with two sharp lateral points (variable in length and sharpness), the anterior margin with a fairly deep notch whose angle is slightly greater than a right angle. Mandibles slender and long, the outer margin evenly and slightly curved, the apex somewhat hooked; both surfaces with fine oblique striae; the inner margin of each mandible with a reduced but rather sharp tooth placed farther from the base than in many related genera; the two mandibles roughly symmetrical; on the left mandible the angle between the base and the tapering part behind the tooth is sharp, nearly a right angle, and on the right mandible the corresponding angle is slightly greater. Pronotum with a deep depression near the middle of the posterior margin, the anterior margin with a distinct deep notch. Fore coxal ridge not sharp, slightly raised in profile. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2; middle tibia with 2 dark spines a little behind the apex on the outer margin.

Measurements (6 soldiers, mm, ranges): head length (including the mandibles) not obtained; head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.34—1.50; head width 1.29—1.38; head thickness (including the postmentum) 1.23—1.28; maximum postmentum width 0.40—0.42; minimum postmentum width 0.38; distance between the two labral points 0.35—0.39; left mandible length 1.41—1.46; distance from the left mandibular tooth to the apex 0.97—0.99; pronotum length 0.33—0.35; pronotum width 0.71—0.74; hind tibia length 0.96—1.06.
